overview_description.description:
Mattermark is a data platform for venture capital companies to quantify signals of growing and potentially lucrative start-ups.

Mattermark offers deal intelligence to the world's leading dealmakers - venture capital, private equity, corporate development, sales, and marketing professionals looking to take a data-driven approach to deal sourcing and due diligence.

The company was launched in 2012 as a data platform for VCs with hopes of becoming the go-to software for firms to use when quantifying signals of growing and potentially lucrative startups.

competitors_list.target_short_description: Momentum is a B2B AI software company that builds tools for sales, marketing, and customer success teams.
Crunchbase is a predictive private company intelligence solution, powered by live company data, AI, and market activity from 80M+ users.
CB Insights is a market intelligence platform that predicts company health and strategy, investor performance, and technology trends.
PitchBook offers financial data and tools on companies, deals, investors, and markets to support sales and business development.
Dealroom.co is a global platform dedicated to the identification and monitoring of startups, growing companies, and venture capital.
Stage 2 Capital is a go-to-market venture capital fund that primarily invests in early-stage B2B software companies.

about_short_description.short_description: Mattermark is a data platform for venture capital companies to quantify signals of growing and potentially lucrative start-ups.

product.name: Company Record
product.description: A database of company profiles with over 80 data fields including geography, industry, revenue, personnel, funding, and employee growth.

product.name: Growth Signals
product.description: Monitors changes in company metrics like team size, web traffic, and media mentions to indicate growth trends.

product.name: Lead Enrichment for Salesforce
product.description: Automatically enriches Salesforce leads with over 80 data fields to provide actionable insights for sales and deal progression.

product.name: Mattermark API
product.description: An API providing access to data on millions of companies for integration and custom modeling.

product.name: Spreadsheet Plugins
product.description: Plugins for Google Sheets and Microsoft Excel to import live updated company data into spreadsheets.

product.name: Web-based Data Browser
product.description: A web interface to browse, filter, and export company data in CSV and PDF formats.
